findings.highlight: in a worse coma than before
findings.evidenceJa: 今までより重い衰弱状態
findings.governingReading: a more severe state of debilitation than previous victims
findings.explanation: The victims’ worsened physical depletion is recast as a deeper or worse coma.

findings.highlight: I don’t think you made a misunderstanding.
findings.evidenceJa: 勘違いしてるとも思えない
findings.governingReading: Rin does not believe Shirou is mistaken
findings.explanation: A basic collocation is rendered as “made a misunderstanding.”

findings.highlight: the scene of the crime yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日の夜、被害のあった現場
findings.governingReading: the site of the harm last night
findings.explanation: The nighttime anchor disappears and an evidentiary “crime scene” classification is added.

findings.highlight: forfeit from the Holy Grail War
findings.governingReading: withdraw from the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: The recurring game-like “forfeit from” phrasing is both unnatural and tonally wrong.

findings.highlight: I try to suppress my face from turning red
findings.evidenceJa: 急速に赤くなりつつある頬を堪えて
findings.governingReading: enduring or trying to contain his rapidly reddening cheeks
findings.explanation: The English uses an unnatural construction in which Shirou suppresses his face.

findings.highlight: Please give me your best regards too
findings.governingReading: although it will probably be only for a short while
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit limit on the provisional alliance disappears.

findings.highlight: Her hand is soft, much more delicate than mine.
findings.governingReading: her hand is faintly cold as well as soft and delicate
findings.explanation: A final tactile detail in Shirou’s reaction disappears.

findings.governingReading: when Rin was consulted by Shirou previously
findings.explanation: A specific earlier consultation becomes their most recent meeting in general.

findings.highlight: Manhow can such an evil smile
findings.evidenceJa: ああこんな邪な笑顔が
findings.governingReading: Man, how can such a wicked smile
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly fuses “Man” and “how.”

findings.highlight: I think I’ll suffer more damage
findings.evidenceJa: 二倍や三倍じゃすまない
findings.governingReading: the shock would not stop at merely two or three times the usual force
findings.explanation: The comic numerical escalation of Rin’s personal impact disappears.

findings.highlight: You’re the type that masturbates to the girl you like, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 好きな子のリコーダーが気になるタイプ
findings.governingReading: the type who becomes preoccupied with the school recorder belonging to a girl he likes
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces the school-crush recorder joke with an explicit unsupported masturbation accusation.
